text: The Registro Mercantil's bulletin (BORME) of 30 September 2025 records for GRIFFIN CORE SOLUTIONS SL, in an entry inscribed on 23 September 2025, that Alejandro Molina Sanchez ceased as sole administrator (administrador único) and that Alejandro and Sergio Molina Sanchez were appointed joint administrators (administradores solidarios), and that its registered office moved to Autovía de la Albufera km 323, Madrid.
short: Griffin Core Solutions S.L. is run by joint administrators Alejandro and Sergio Molina Sanchez (BORME, 2025).

source.name: BORME-A-2025-186-28 (Boletín Oficial del Registro Mercantil, Madrid), entry 426558 GRIFFIN CORE SOLUTIONS SL
source.quote: 426558 - GRIFFIN CORE SOLUTIONS SL. Ceses/Dimisiones. Adm. Unico: MOLINA SANCHEZ ALEJANDRO. Nombramientos. Adm. Solid.: MOLINA SANCHEZ ALEJANDRO;MOLINA SANCHEZ SERGIO.
source.note: Same entry: 'Cambio del Organo de Administración: Administrador único a Administradores solidarios. Cambio de domicilio social. AUTOV DE LA ALBUFERA Km 323 ... (MADRID). Datos registrales. S 8 , H M 746763, I/A 2 (23.09.25).' The bulletin names the administrators, not the shareholders.
